scope: Explicitly authored development queries against synthetic fixtures. Cases and relevance judgments were written while implementing the retriever. Not independent, held-out, clinical, or real-world performance evidence.
relevance_unit: Document; any retrieved chunk from an explicitly relevant document counts. Repeated document IDs are deduplicated before applying k.

queries.question: Alpha packaging expiry
queries.judgment: The Alpha certificate contains the packaging expiry date.

queries.question: Alpha manufacture
queries.judgment: The Alpha certificate gives its manufacture date.

queries.question: HDPE Bottle 60 mL
queries.judgment: Only the Alpha fixture identifies this material.

queries.question: supplier audit
queries.judgment: Only Beta contains an extracted audit date.

queries.question: Microcrystalline Cellulose
queries.judgment: Only the Beta fixture identifies this material.
